xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5371: Simple Home says '18 things need you' while the top bar says 'Needs you · 8': two needs-you rules

plan.title: Simple Home says '18 things need you' while the top bar says 'Needs you · 8': two needs-you rules
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Simple Home's headline counts bucketSimpleHome(...).needsYou plus extra questions, which includes every plan waiting for Start work, every stuck agent and every changes-requested issue. The top bar counts useNeedsYouItems().length (pending input, issue attention needs-you, Flywheel rows, decisions). On :3011 they showed 18 vs 8. Simple Home also fails to list Flywheel rows, decisions and issue-less pending input that the top bar counts.
narratives.Proposal: Option 1 from the issue (PAN-5284 D-8 rules pipeline states out of the Needs-you list). Simple Home's h1 and Needs-you section use useNeedsYouItems(): one card per shared item, chosen by a new pure helper lib/simple/needsYouCards.ts. The Simple reasons the selector does not count (start-work, stuck, problems) render in two new sections, Ready to start and Having trouble, outside the count, minus any issue already listed as a Needs-you card. One test renders NeedsYouIndicator and SimpleHomePage with the real selectors and proves the numbers and the card list agree. Docs and a changelog entry describe the change. Full detail, decision rules N-D1..N-D10 and before/after code: .pan/drafts/PAN-5371.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- The Kanban NeedsYouStrip keeps its bucketSimpleHome rule and count (follow-up PAN-5413).
- No change to buildNeedsYouItems/useNeedsYouItems semantics; the top bar, Advanced Home and project Home numbers do not change.
- No change to bucketSimpleHome, deriveSimpleIssue, userFacingDisplay or SimpleIssuePage.
- The two pre-existing SimpleIssuePage failures in simple-pages.test.tsx are not fixed here.
- Runtime decision labels are not rewritten into simple-mode copy, except the Flywheel item title.
- No server change and no new HTTP route.
- A question the shared selector treats as resolved (answered or dismissed) and whose pane is not blocked no longer shows on Simple Home, matching the top bar; changing the resolution rule is a selector change.

autoDecisions.summary: Option 1: Simple Home uses useNeedsYouItems().length; plan-ready issues get their own section outside the count.
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-5284 D-8 (.pan/drafts/pan-5284.md line 61) says work-not-started/ready and similar 'are pipeline states, not needs-you items'. Option 2 would contradict N-D8 and change the top bar, Advanced Home and project Home numbers PAN-5292 just aligned.

autoDecisions.summary: Stuck and problems (changes-requested) also leave the count and render under a 'Having trouble' section.
autoDecisions.rationale: The shared selector does not count them either; N-D8 lists the canonical sources and they are not among them. A section keeps them visible with their existing actions.

autoDecisions.summary: Simple 'question' derivations not in the shared list are not shown on Simple Home.
autoDecisions.rationale: Outside the shared list a question is answered, dismissed, or a kind-less phantom wait that PAN-1591 deliberately excludes from Needs you.

autoDecisions.summary: Flywheel items show the title 'A decision is waiting' in simple mode.
autoDecisions.rationale: The selector titles them 'Flywheel', which is in simple mode's BANNED_WORDS list.

autoDecisions.summary: The Kanban NeedsYouStrip is out of scope; filed as PAN-5413.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names only Simple Home and the top bar; the strip is a separate surface with its own card layout and actions.
